layer_vocabulary.L0: REPRESENTABILITY — is the invalid semantic state constructible at all through the relevant boundary
layer_vocabulary.L1: TYPE / STATIC API — compiler, type system, access control, negative compile, structural authority gate
layer_vocabulary.L2: CONTRACT / FAIL-FAST — explicit runtime validation, death test, invariant assertion, named process-terminal fail-fast
layer_vocabulary.L3: ORDINARY REGRESSION — unit / integration / regression tests, deterministic unit scenario
layer_vocabulary.L7: GENMC / WEAK-MEMORY MODEL — bounded weak-memory execution witness
layer_vocabulary.L8: DETERMINISTIC SCHEDULING / DST — controlled scheduling/replay witness
layer_vocabulary.L9: REAL BACKEND — ThreadPool / real io_uring / OS execution where applicable
layer_vocabulary.L10: EXTERNAL OBSERVABILITY — what the user actually sees if all mechanism layers miss

status_vocabulary.PREVENTS: Layer makes the invalid state impossible.
status_vocabulary.REJECTS: Invalid attempt reaches the layer but is mechanically rejected.
status_vocabulary.DETECTS: Defect executes/reaches state and layer catches it.
status_vocabulary.REPRODUCES: Layer does not prevent/detect by itself but makes the failure deterministically reproducible.
status_vocabulary.MISSES: Hazard can occur and this layer does not catch it.
status_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: Layer is semantically irrelevant to this hazard.
status_vocabulary.NOT_MODELED: Layer could matter, but no corresponding model exists (or the model is only ADJACENT to the hazard law).
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: Fair test cannot currently be constructed (reason required).
status_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: Test result is ambiguous or flaky (reason required).
status_vocabulary._l10_convention: L10 records the residual user-visible outcome when all mechanism layers miss: MISSES with the failure form in notes, or NOT_APPLICABLE when no residual silent path remains on the Sluice side.
